text_block_list.text:
(Wait, just one protagonist against a 
horde of enemies!? How are they supposed 
to—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(The sworn ally swordsman appears here?! 
Now that's a thrilling turn of 
events...!!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is it already this late...? Oh no, I 
gotta get to sleep right now~~...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So engrossed in her favorite novel, Zenno 
Rob Roy ended up staying up late into the 
night...
